import ast as _aqrp_ast

        _aqrp_sys.modules.pop(_aqrp_name, None)
_aqrp_importlib.invalidate_caches()
_aqrp_spec = _aqrp_import_util.find_spec('qresearch')
_aqrp_locations = list(_aqrp_spec.submodule_search_locations or ()) if _aqrp_spec is not None else []
if len(_aqrp_locations) != 1 or not isinstance(_aqrp_locations[0], str) or not _aqrp_locations[0]:
    raise ValueError('Frozen Research implementation root is unavailable or ambiguous')
if not _aqrp_Path(_aqrp_locations[0]).is_absolute():
    raise ValueError('Frozen Research implementation root is unavailable or ambiguous')
_aqrp_root = _aqrp_Path(_aqrp_locations[0]).resolve().parent
_aqrp_input = (_aqrp_root / '_engineering_task_input.py').read_bytes()
if _aqrp_hashlib.sha256(_aqrp_input).hexdigest() != '03dd4dcc9cf99c44496236b70370cb8785105d05523cd098798408bfa17c917b':
    raise ValueError('Frozen Research input identity differs')
_aqrp_tree = _aqrp_ast.parse(_aqrp_input.decode('utf-8-sig'))
if (len(_aqrp_tree.body) != 1 or not isinstance(_aqrp_tree.body[0], _aqrp_ast.Assign)
        or len(_aqrp_tree.body[0].targets) != 1
        or not isinstance(_aqrp_tree.body[0].targets[0], _aqrp_ast.Name)
        or _aqrp_tree.body[0].targets[0].id != 'TASK_INPUT_JSON'
        or not isinstance(_aqrp_tree.body[0].value, _aqrp_ast.Constant)
        or not isinstance(_aqrp_tree.body[0].value.value, str)):
    raise ValueError('Frozen Research input must be one inert JSON assignment')
_aqrp_payload = _aqrp_json.loads(_aqrp_tree.body[0].value.value)
if not isinstance(_aqrp_payload, dict) or _aqrp_payload.get('identity') != {'attempt_id': 'f5d05f5b964b4a1d924e4b70cd207386', 'config_id': '8552b4c1f96caf63b56fc95c8ebcd5e43598b81e14e7c5ae62eb21913225f5b1', 'data_request_hash': '36d0053dae0f3a302c42b67946ec1fe469ad76c482d0bcbf26afaeccc298cbc2', 'deployment_hash': '3227c82d09fde3aaddeea61e82aa7e7845ca67b4ff817e932edd145b82b64118', 'plan_hash': '4c67e2b61b6d1955a7f94948756aa7277b6f076adfaab5e1fbc14470ec599da7', 'project_id': 38436695, 'source_manifest_hash': '89bc58058beab1315d3fa82fee8c0f22d6272fd80152b1938987453acc78a8c6', 'stage': 'research'}:
    raise ValueError('Frozen Research input identity differs')
from qresearch.engineering_data import run_research_task as _aqrp_run
from qresearch.artifacts import canonical_json as _aqrp_canonical
_aqrp_result = _aqrp_run(_aqrp_payload)
